licence_basis.reason: Author Charlotte Mary Yonge (1823–1901) died in 1901. Economic rights expire 70 years after the author's death, counted from the end of that year (Polish Copyright Act, art. 36), so the work has been in the public domain since 1972-01-01. The text was read from Project Gutenberg eBook #70419 (released 2023-03-30), a proofread transcription of the new, revised edition (London: Macmillan and Co., 1884).

rights.notes: Public domain by the author's death date; no lawyer has reviewed it, hence LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED. Attribution required because authors' moral rights do not expire in Polish law. Name Atlas quotes the 1884 text and cites the edition; the Project Gutenberg licence governs the eBook file and the Project Gutenberg name, neither of which is reproduced. image_rights UNKNOWN: no image is reproduced. The meanings are in English; D-046 §2 allows a literal Polish translation beside each, marked as Name Atlas's. Reliability tier C is this session's classification of a Victorian survey by a novelist, the lowest tier ADR-0008 admits; the product always shows author and year beside the reading.
